facts.gradeRange: The rock is of great quality and as it is often weathered into fins and flutings which enables hard looking faces to be climbed also at moderate grades.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Val di Mello is an alpine granite valley in the Val Masino area, with climbing styles ranging from bouldering to long routes.

sections.heading: Rock And Climbing Character
sections.body: The guidebook page describes towering granite walls, hundreds of long multi-pitch routes and many crack, corner and groove features.

sections.heading: Grades And Scale
sections.body: The source describes hundreds of long routes and wall lengths up to about 800 m.

sections.heading: Season
sections.body: The legacy packet says Val di Mello bouldering is suited to summer and that the best time for mountain lines is July to early autumn.
